description: UI pass 1: shell + container + header/device selector + Create + Templates. Depends on FEAT-001 (store, encoders, quality), FEAT-002 (Select, Dialog, ConfirmDialog, Tooltip, Menu) and FEAT-003 (decodeQrImage for Verify scan). Replaces the v1 page body. Review findings addressed here: NIT 6 (header Select placeholder 'Select device' when activeDevice is '' or not in devices, no auto-switch, Device Actions treat as no device), MEDIUM 1 source assignment in the Create save paths, carried-over: removal of the three qr-studio shell-hiding conditionals in src/App.tsx (l.~1987, 2002, 2005) with a shellChromeForRoute test, window.confirm removal, v2 storage in use (v1 never written), 12 content types in Create, templates. Library/DeviceActions/Tools destinations are mounted as minimal clearly-marked placeholder panels ONLY until FEAT-005/FEAT-006 replace them (the final review rejects any placeholder left).
steps: Read context.json, design.md 1, 3, 4, 9 and design-review.md finding 6. Run `grep -rn "qr-studio" src` (quote the pattern, no glob) and read src/navigation/appRoutes.test.ts, src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.test.tsx and src/App.tsx around l.361-364, 591-600, 655-665, 1575-1585, 1980-2010 and the qrStudio prop usage.

Shell chrome: create src/navigation/shellChrome.ts exporting shellChromeForRoute(route: AppRoute): {navigation:boolean; footer:boolean; tabBar:boolean} returning all true for every route; src/navigation/shellChrome.test.ts asserts all-true for 'qr-studio', for 'dashboard' and by iterating every id exported by src/navigation/appRoutes.ts. Edit src/App.tsx: delete exactly the three qr-studio conditionals (navigation prop, footer prop, `activeRoute !== 'qr-studio' &&` before WorkspaceTabBar) and drive them from shellChromeForRoute. Add src/components/app-shell/AppShell.test.tsx rendering AppShell with navigation, footer and a tab-bar child and asserting all three are in the document. Pass new props from App: devices, deviceLabels (workspaceDeviceLabels), activeDevice (activeAndroidWorkspaceDevice), onSelectDevice={(serial)=>{setActiveDevice(serial); setActiveIosUdid(null); setActiveCompanionWorkspaceId(null)}} (NOT openDeviceWorkspace, which navigates away), customPath={config.scrcpyPath}, notify (existing ToolbarNotifier). Update OtherPages.tsx only if the prop plumbing for qrStudio needs the new props (keep the route mapping).

Container: src/components/qr-studio/destinations.ts (QR_DESTINATIONS exactly as design 1.2, plus QR_TOOLS ids 'deep-link-builder'|'wifi'|'decoder'|'quality'); rewrite src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.tsx as a thin container (<200 lines) with useQrStore, useQrDraft (src/components/qr-studio/useQrDraft.ts: draft lives in the container so it survives tab switches; fields, type, name, style, mode, editingId, dirty), active destination in useState persisted to sessionStorage key `scrcpy-gui-plus:qr-studio:tab`, exactly one mounted panel, root class `h-full min-h-0` with an internal scroll container (never min-h-screen/h-screen), no Dashboard back button (keep optional onExit prop for API compat). Header QrStudioHeader.tsx: icon, title, tab bar (role=tablist/tab/tabpanel, aria-selected, roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End, aria-labelledby; icon-only with aria-label + Tooltip when the container is narrower than 1100px via src/components/qr-studio/useContainerWidth.ts using ResizeObserver with overridable initial width for tests), Saved/Links counts, QrDeviceSelect.

NIT 6: src/components/qr-studio/QrDeviceSelect.tsx wraps the FEAT-002 Select over the `devices` prop, label deviceLabels[serial] ?? serial; when devices is empty show a disabled 'No device connected'; when activeDevice is '' (iOS/companion workspace) or not in devices show the placeholder 'Select device' (no orphan value), never auto-switch; choosing an option calls onSelectDevice. Export a pure `hasAndroidTarget(devices, activeDevice)` used by Device Actions later (false for '' or unknown serial). Tests: renders placeholder for '' and for an unplugged serial, lists devices with labels, calls onSelectDevice with the serial, disabled state when no devices, does not call onSelectDevice on mount.

Create panel (src/components/qr-studio/CreatePanel.tsx + TypePicker, TypeFields, DesignControls, LivePreview, QualityPanel, CreateAside): 12 types via qrEncoders with per-field validation and inline errors; single and bulk mode (parseMultiQrInput, per-line validation, 'Save N valid, skip M invalid' confirm, limit 200 lines); LivePreview keeps the 180 ms debounced generateQrSvg + styleQrSvg, shows inline error and dimmed last-good preview on failure with Save disabled; colour inputs are real (replace the old 'Customize' click() hack), size 256-4096 clamped, EC L/M/Q/H, name <=80; QualityPanel from qrQuality (error disables Save/Download, warn allows); actions Download PNG, Download SVG (reuse the old downloadBlob/downloadSvg/PNG helpers by moving them into src/components/qr-studio/qrDownloads.ts, using getRecordSvg-style generation, never reading a record's .svg directly), Copy (image to clipboard when available else the content text, label says which), Save, Reset (ConfirmDialog only when dirty), Save as template (name <=40 case-insensitive unique), 'Verify scan' (rasterise styled SVG to a 512px canvas PNG, call decodeQrImage, states Verified/Mismatch/Could not decode, disabled with 'Requires the desktop app' when Tauri is absent; mock the service in tests). Save semantics (MEDIUM 1): new record -> source 'created'; editing an existing record uses saveEditedFromCreate (source preserved unless content changed, then 'created'); Edit of a record without fields uses parseFields and falls back to type 'custom' with the hint 'Structured fields could not be restored'. Layout (assumption: the brief's 3-column Create wins over design 9 at wide widths): measured container width >= 1200px -> 3 columns [form | preview+actions+quality | CreateAside]; 1024-1199 -> 2 columns (aside stacked under preview); < 1024 -> single column with preview above form (collapsible). CreateAside in this FEAT renders the Tools shortcut list (4 buttons that switch destination to Tools with that tool selected, via an onOpenTool prop) and a Device Actions section slot that FEAT-006 fills; no non-functional buttons.

Templates panel (TemplatesPanel.tsx) per design 4: built-ins not deletable; cards with live mini QR from a cached sample SVG via styleQrSvg; Apply to Create (switch destination + set draft style), Apply to selected library records (bulk restyle; disabled with 'Select records in Library first' when none selected - selection is held in the container so Library can share it; wire the selection prop now with an empty set until FEAT-005), Rename (inline, validated), Delete user template via ConfirmDialog; contrast warning shown when applying a low-contrast template but not blocking.

Placeholders: LibraryPanel.tsx, DeviceActionsPanel.tsx, ToolsPanel.tsx each render a titled panel with the text 'Not implemented yet' and `data-testid="qr-placeholder"` so FEAT-005/006 and the final reviewer can find and remove them. Remove the legacy v1 page code (old Library, window.confirm usage, ArrowLeft Dashboard button) and the now-unused LegacyQrRecord/loadQrRecords/saveQrRecords exports (update qrStudioService.test.ts accordingly; keep the parseMultiQrInput/styleQrSvg/qrFileName tests). Move colorContrast usage to qrQuality.

Tests: rewrite src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.test.tsx around the new container (keep the intent of the 5 originals: create+persist to the v2 key, bulk create, cancel edit, contrast warning; the Dashboard-button test becomes 'does not render a Dashboard button'); add: only the active panel is mounted (query for other panels' roots returns null), tab keyboard navigation, draft survives switching tabs and back, Create validation per type (wifi, email, phone, sms, location, event, contact, deep-link, app-link), Reset confirms only when dirty, Edit of an old v1-migrated record opens as custom with the hint, saving an edit with changed content flips source to 'created' and unchanged content preserves it, Verify scan states with the service mocked, no `window.confirm` call (spy on window.confirm and assert not called), templates apply/rename/delete/duplicate-name rejection, svgAccess.test.ts still passes.
Run verification; commit `feat(qr-studio): 5-destination shell, device selector, Create and Templates`.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run src/navigation src/components/app-shell src/components/qr-studio src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.test.tsx src/services` passes

src/App.tsx contains no `'qr-studio'` conditional that hides navigation, footer or tab bar (`grep -n "qr-studio" src/App.tsx` shows only route wiring, none of the three removed conditionals) and shellChrome.test.ts passes for every route id
QrStudioPage.tsx is a container under 200 lines, root uses h-full min-h-0, and only the active destination panel is mounted
Header device Select shows 'Select device' when activeDevice is '' or not in devices and never calls onSelectDevice unprompted
`window.confirm` is not referenced anywhere under src/components/qr-studio or src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.tsx
`npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` pass; the v1 storage key is never written (test asserts v1 string unchanged after a save)
verification: npx vitest run src/navigation src/components/app-shell src/components/qr-studio src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.test.tsx src/services
findings: DONE, commit 3bdf23c 'feat(qr-studio): 5-destination shell, device selector, Create and Templates' on branch feat/qr-studio-refactor (local, not pushed). Verified: scoped vitest (navigation, app-shell, qr-studio, QrStudioPage.test, services) 39 files / 269 tests pass; npx tsc --noEmit clean; npm run build ok; full `npx vitest run` 784 pass, only the 2 UNRELATED pre-existing ControlPanel.test.tsx failures (renderer select, from scrcpy 5.0.1 commit e00d802). svgAccess.test.ts passes. No Rust/Cargo/npm dependency change. SHELL: src/navigation/shellChrome.ts shellChromeForRoute(route: AppRouteId) (type is AppRouteId, not AppRoute) all true; App.tsx uses `shellChrome.navigation && ...`, `shellChrome.footer && ...`, `shellChrome.tabBar && ...`; `grep -n qr-studio src/App.tsx` is now empty (route wiring lives in OtherPages/appRoutes). App passes devices, deviceLabels=workspaceDeviceLabels, activeDevice=activeAndroidWorkspaceDevice, onSelectDevice (setActiveDevice + clear iOS/companion, no navigation), customPath, notify. AppShell.test.tsx added. CONTAINER (src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.tsx, 181 lines): props {onExit?(unused, no Dashboard button), devices, deviceLabels?, activeDevice, onSelectDevice, customPath?, notify, initialWidth?(test hook, default 1280)}. Holds useQrStore, useQrDraft, destination (sessionStorage `scrcpy-gui-plus:qr-studio:tab`), `tool` (QrToolId, default 'deep-link-builder'), `selection` (ReadonlySet<string> of record ids, shared Library<->Templates), status toast (setStatus, 2.4 s). Root `relative flex h-full min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col`, tabpanel is the scroll container. Exactly one panel mounted. editRecord(record) = draftApi.startEdit(record) + switch to 'create' (passed to LibraryPanel as onEditRecord). StoreBanners shows persistError (role=alert), load notice, Start fresh (readOnly) and Dismiss. FOR FEAT-005 (Library): replace src/components/qr-studio/LibraryPanel.tsx. Its props type already is LibraryPanelProps {store: UseQrStore, selection, onSelectionChange(ReadonlySet<string>), onEditRecord(record)}; the file currently renders a PLACEHOLDER (data-testid="qr-placeholder", text 'Not implemented yet', `_props` unused) that must be deleted. Edit entry point is onEditRecord; the draft's baseline/dirty logic is in useQrDraft. Use getRecordSvg for thumbnails; avoid the `.svg` property pattern (svgAccess test also scans comments). Templates 'Apply to selected' already reads `selection` and restyles via store.saveEditedFromCreate (preserves source, drops stored svg only if EC changes). Shared UI classes (panelClass, inputClass, labelClass, primaryButtonClass, secondaryButtonClass, outlineButtonClass) and TextField/Segmented/CheckField/Section are exported from src/components/qr-studio/formControls.tsx. Downloads helpers (downloadSvg/downloadPng/copyQr/canCopyImage/renderPngBase64/svgToPngBlob/blobToBase64, QrRenderable) are in qrDownloads.ts and all go through getRecordSvg. FOR FEAT-006 (Device Actions, Tools): replace DeviceActionsPanel.tsx (props DeviceActionsPanelProps {store, devices, deviceLabels?, activeDevice, customPath?, notify}) and ToolsPanel.tsx (props {store, tool: QrToolId, onSelectTool}); both are PLACEHOLDERS with data-testid="qr-placeholder" (ToolsPanel also sets data-tool). hasAndroidTarget(devices, activeDevice) is exported from QrDeviceSelect.tsx (false for '' or an unknown serial). destinations.ts exports QR_DESTINATIONS, QR_TOOLS (ids 'deep-link-builder'|'wifi'|'decoder'|'quality'), QrToolId, QR_TAB_STORAGE_KEY, isQrDestination. CreateAside accepts an optional `deviceActions?: ReactNode` slot but CreatePanel does not pass one yet (renders only the 4 Tools shortcut buttons, which call onOpenTool -> container switches to Tools with that tool); FEAT-006 must add the slot content in CreatePanel (`<CreateAside onOpenTool=... deviceActions={...}/>`) and add a test. The Page test 'switches destination to Tools from the Create aside' asserts the placeholder has data-tool='decoder' and must be updated when ToolsPanel is real. Page tests 'mounts only the active destination panel' also reference qr-placeholder and the 'Library' placeholder heading. CREATE: files CreatePanel, TypePicker (Select of 12 types, aria-label 'Type'), TypeFields, DesignControls (real color inputs: swatch input type=color + hex text input labeled Foreground/Background; EC segmented L/M/Q/H; size number 256-4096 clamped on blur, MAX_SIZE_PX/clampSize exported from DesignControls; 'Apply template' Select), LivePreview (useQrPreview hook, 180 ms debounce, keeps last good preview dimmed on failure/invalid, data-testid qr-live-preview), QualityPanel (assessQrQuality issues, contrast ratio, Verify result), CreateAside, qrBulk.ts (validateBulkInput/validateBulkLine, MAX_BULK_LINES 200: simple types use bare value, wifi/contact/event/location/sms need raw encoded content that parseFields accepts). Layout by measured container width: >=1200 'wide' 3 columns, 1024-1199 'medium' 2 columns (aside stacked), <1024 'narrow' single column with collapsible preview; root element has data-layout. Tabs go icon-only (aria-label + Tooltip) under 1100 px (COMPACT_TABS_BELOW). Field errors show only for touched fields until Save is clicked (Save stays enabled for invalid fields so the click reveals errors); Save is disabled for quality errors (contrast<2, capacity, roundtrip mismatch) or preview failure. Download PNG/SVG, Copy (label 'Copy image' when ClipboardItem exists else 'Copy text'), Verify scan (disabled with 'Requires the desktop app' when !isTauri() from src/utils/tauriEnv; states Verified/Mismatch/Could not decode; result is invalidated when content/colors/EC change). Save semantics: new -> store.saveRecord({source:'created', fields}); editing -> store.saveEditedFromCreate. DEVIATION to note: an untouched Edit (draftApi.fieldsChanged false) saves the record's ORIGINAL stored content, because encoders normalise (URL gets a trailing '/') and that would otherwise be seen as a content change and flip source to 'created'. Edit of a record without restorable fields opens as type 'custom' with hint FIELDS_NOT_RESTORED_HINT ('Structured fields could not be restored', role=note) and saves content unchanged with source preserved. Reset/Cancel editing use useConfirm only when draft is dirty. Save as template uses a Dialog (name <=40, case-insensitive unique via store.saveTemplate). Notices: success toasts go through onStatus (container); notify (ToolbarNotifier, a modal alert in App) is used only for export/copy failures. TEMPLATES: TemplatesPanel props {store, selection, onApplyToCreate(style), onStatus}; cards are <article aria-label=name>; built-ins have no Rename/Delete; user templates inline rename (TextField 'Template name', buttons 'Save name'/'Cancel'), delete via useConfirm ('Delete template'); mini QRs come from one cached generateQrSvg('https://example.com','M') sample styled with styleQrSvg (resetTemplateSample() exported for tests; web-only without Tauri falls back to a swatch); applying a low-contrast (<3:1) template shows a warning on the card and in the status text but is not blocked; 'Apply to selected' disabled with the hint 'Select records in Library first to enable "Apply to selected"' until selection has live records. CLEANUP: removed LegacyQrRecord type and loadQrRecords/saveQrRecords (v1 key is only ever read by the v2 migration; test asserts the v1 string is unchanged after a save). Old page code, window.confirm, ArrowLeft Dashboard button and the page-local colorContrast are gone (qrQuality.colorContrast is used). `grep window.confirm src/components/qr-studio src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.tsx` is empty; the 'never calls window.confirm' spy assertions live in src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.test.tsx (file name differs from QrStudioPage.tsx). TEST NOTES: tests that open Select/Dialog need no layout mocks. Page tests mock ../../services/deepLinkService, ../../services/qrDeviceService, ../../utils/tauriEnv and partially ../qr-studio/qrDownloads (renderPngBase64). CreatePanel.test.tsx uses a Harness with useQrStore + useQrDraft to exercise Edit (there is no Library UI yet) and covers all 12 types' validation. The source files are auto-formatted by a save hook (multi-line imports); string-replace scripts against test files should re-read first. KNOWN LIMITS / NOT DONE: no visual verification yet (jsdom cannot prove clipping or zoom); the 3-column Create layout (brief) was chosen over design section 9's 2 columns at wide widths as the task said; bulk mode has no live preview; Event input uses native datetime-local/date inputs.
